items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Captain Knox called to me one day... I'm making you a member of my non-commissioned staff

ctx.x: were you stationed you I first went into the Army in 1942 I was drafted right here at Fort Jackson right here in central Louisiana not not not camp no well I got discharged from camp Polk but anyway I was trained at Fort McClellan Alabama in the infantry with the 92nd Division which is one of the largest and one of the most professional group of black soldiers ever put together by United States only who were segregated but we were big time soldiers you see and that was the infantry having good legs and having a…

called to me one day, said look, we need your craftsmanship, you're training all these soldiers to go overseas, but I'm going to keep you here. I said, but look, these are my soldiers, Captain, I'm training. No, you got to stay here, we got to put you in special services. I said, what is that? What is that?
